decision: Do not integrate parallel-copy, streaming-store, upfront page preparation or huge-page hint as a default on this evidence.
scope: External serialized experiments on one repeated 5-token/64-output Flash trajectory. OS filesystem cache uncontrolled; model/GPU preparation excluded. Page preparation cost explicit. Not a vLLM or sustained serving comparison.

copy_experiment.scope: External serial linker-wrapper experiment; no runtime changes. Three requests per process, retained caches, uncontrolled filesystem cache, no concurrency or vLLM comparison. Single trajectory; timings exploratory and one reversed-order repeat only.

page_preparation_experiment.scope: External allocation wrapper; managed cache contents start empty, optional write touch commits slab pages before model/GPU preparation. Preparation cost is explicit and must be added back for startup-to-first-request accounting. No physical disk, general workload or performance parity claim.
